final.role: Motor de busca full-text em memoria (JS) para indexar notas Markdown do hub, com prefixo, fuzzy e boost
final.evidence: MiniSearch is a tiny but powerful in-memory fulltext search engine written in JavaScript. Exact match, prefix search, fuzzy match, field boosting. Default tokenizer splits on Unicode space or punctuation; no stemming.
